input.quote: 13.5 SFJ Representation, Warranty and Covenant. SFJ hereby represents, warrants and covenants that it will have, as and when needed, sufficient funds to satisfy its obligations hereunder.
input.rationale: SFJ's only warranty is the funding covenant in Section 13.5; nothing in Articles 3 or 13 warrants the quality or conformity of the SFJ Services (CRO oversight and execution of the Clinical Trials in the SFJ Territory), and Section 13.6.2 disclaims all warranties except those set out in Article 13. That is walk-away territory (no conformance warranty and a sweeping disclaimer), so we propose the fallback: a 30-day conformance warranty for the SFJ Services with repair/replacement or refund remedies, inserted in Article 13 so the 13.6.2 carve-out preserves it. Flagged needs_review because the fallback's software-to-documentation element cannot apply here: the Agreement contains no software, deliverables or documentation supplied by SFJ.

ops.text: SFJ Services Warranty. SFJ hereby represents and warrants that the SFJ Services will conform in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement for a period of thirty (30) days following performance. For any breach of this warranty, SFJ will, at PB's election, re-perform, repair or replace the non-conforming SFJ Services or refund to PB the amounts paid for them.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] SFJ currently warrants only that it will have sufficient funds, while Section 13.6.2 disclaims every warranty outside Article 13, leaving the SFJ Services effectively un-warranted. We added our fallback position: a 30-day conformance warranty for the SFJ Services with repair, replacement or refund as the remedy, placed in Article 13 so the disclaimer's carve-out preserves it.
proposal.summary: Add a 30-day SFJ Services performance warranty with repair/replacement and refund remedies inside Article 13.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
mappings.explanation: The Agreement involves no software, deliverables or documentation supplied by SFJ (searches for "software" and "Deliverable" return no hits); SFJ's role is funding plus the defined SFJ Services (CRO oversight and Clinical Trial execution). Adding a software conformance warranty would be inoperative boilerplate, so this element is left unaddressed for business confirmation that no SFJ-supplied software or documented deliverable exists.

mappings.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
